description: Migrate saved formula measures for all data models from source to target.

examples.user_query: Migrate all saved formulas, skipping any that already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates all saved formula measures from the source environment to the target, skipping any formulas that already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate all saved formulas and overwrite any existing ones?
examples.notes: This call migrates all saved formula measures from the source environment to the target, overwriting any formulas that already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: Can I duplicate all saved formulas during migration?
examples.notes: This call migrates all saved formula measures from the source environment to the target, duplicating any formulas that already exist on the target.

description: Migrate saved formula measures for specific data models from source to target.

datamodel_ids.description: Data model OIDs to migrate. Provide either this or ``datamodel_names``.

datamodel_names.description: Data model titles to migrate. Provide either this or ``datamodel_ids``.

action.description: Conflict strategy for formulas whose ``title`` already exists on the target datasource. - ``"skip"`` — leave the existing formula unchanged (default). - ``"overwrite"`` or ``"duplicate"`` — always create, regardless of conflicts. The Sisense metadata API exposes no update or delete endpoint for saved formulas, so ``"overwrite"`` cannot replace the existing formula in place and behaves identically to ``"duplicate"``.

examples.user_query: Migrate all saved formulas for data models 'Sales Dashboard' and 'Marketing Dashboard', skipping any that already exist.
examples.notes: This call migrates saved formulas for the specified data models by their names, using the 'skip' strategy to avoid duplicating formulas that already exist on the target.

examples.user_query: How can I migrate saved formulas for data models with IDs '12345' and '67890', overwriting any conflicts?
examples.notes: This call migrates saved formulas for the specified data models by their IDs, using the 'overwrite' strategy to handle conflicts by creating new formulas regardless of existing ones.

examples.user_query: I need to duplicate all saved formulas from the 'Finance Dashboard' data model to the target.
examples.notes: This call migrates saved formulas for the 'Finance Dashboard' data model, using the 'duplicate' strategy to ensure all formulas are created on the target, even if they already exist.
